$comment: The operating-ledger export, as text. JSON because the web bundle must carry it and a bundler reads JSON natively — the same way the USGS, OpenAQ and UCR fixtures are carried. It is NOT pre-normalized: this is the CSV an exporter writes, parsed at runtime by the same reader an uploaded file goes through. An earlier attempt kept it as a template literal in a .ts module and Prettier silently normalised the CRLF endings out of it; data in a formatted source file is data the formatter owns.
